reason: The Ledgers filter chip in the Search or jump to dialog is exposed as button "Ledgers" with no state (ax probe). Pressing Enter on a chip moves the active style to it and changes the results, but no chip carries aria-pressed, aria-selected or aria-checked, so the selected filter is visual only. This fails 4.1.2 (state) and 1.3.1. Search still works unfiltered, but a screen-reader user cannot tell which filter is on, so medium.
